items.question: What does the chapter state in the source passage beginning “97 Tapestry of the Past 4 – Turning Tides: 11th and…”?
items.answer: 97 Tapestry of the Past 4 – Turning Tides: 11th and 12th Centuries Turning Tides: 11th and 12th Centuries CHAPTER4 It is the same India which has withstood the shocks of centuries, of hundreds of foreign invasions, of hundreds of upheavals of manners and customs.
